scope: Targeted primary/publisher page and abstracts, not systematic/exhaustive review

sources.title: Survey Paper on Raga Recommendation Based on Emotion Identification
sources.authors: Bhakti Mandlik; Amogh Thakur; Om Varma
sources.venue: International Journal of Creative Research Thoughts 11(4)
sources.assessment: Verified first and methodology/conclusion pages of five-page PDF; concept and proposed pipeline precede MAQAM; do not infer deployed performance.

sources.title: LyEmoBERT: Classification of lyrics’ emotion and recommendation using a pre-trained model
sources.authors: Author list not independently verified in this audit
sources.assessment: Publisher abstract/metadata indexed; article body not reviewed; lyrics emotion classification and recommendation already studied, not Raag selection.

sources.title: Exploring LLMs for South Asian Music Understanding and Generation
sources.authors: Faria Binte Kader; Mohtasim Hadi Rafi; Shah Wasif Sajjad; Santu Karmaker
sources.assessment: Verified arXiv abstract; evaluates 33 LLMs on Raag/Taal reasoning and music-generation tasks; NOT evidence that our exact poetry task was studied; peer review unverified.

sources.title: Explainable Deep Learning Analysis for Raga Identification in Indian Art Music
sources.assessment: Read HTML abstract, method and conclusion: audio Raag identification/expert annotations, not poetry-to-Raag recommendation.

sources.title: Indian Art Music Raga Recognition Dataset
sources.assessment: Audio recordings and associated Raag annotations; different task and modality; not an eligible poetry benchmark.

sources.title: Shortcut learning in deep neural networks
sources.assessment: Foundational conceptual synthesis of shortcuts; discovery not new to MAQAM.

sources.title: Right for the Wrong Reasons: Diagnosing Syntactic Heuristics in Natural Language Inference
sources.authors: R. Thomas McCoy; Ellie Pavlick; Tal Linzen
sources.assessment: HANS stress test for models exploiting heuristics; controlled challenge data precedent.

sources.title: Beyond Accuracy: Behavioral Testing of NLP Models with CheckList
sources.authors: Marco Tulio Ribeiro; Tongshuang Wu; Carlos Guestrin; Sameer Singh
sources.assessment: Task-agnostic NLP behavioral tests existed; using perturbations is not novel itself.

sources.title: Evaluating Models’ Local Decision Boundaries via Contrast Sets
sources.assessment: Small meaningful interventions and contrast sets predating MAQAM.

sources.title: Robustness to Spurious Correlations in Text Classification via Automatically Generated Counterfactuals
sources.assessment: Counterfactual training/mitigation is prior work; our balanced-time training is an application only.

sources.title: Towards Faithfully Interpretable NLP Systems: How Should We Define and Evaluate Faithfulness?
sources.assessment: Distinguishes explanation presentation and faithfulness; trace visibility is not a validated faithful explanation.

sources.title: Towards Faithful Model Explanation in NLP: A Survey
sources.authors: Qing Lyu; Marianna Apidianaki; Chris Callison-Burch
sources.assessment: Comprehensive explanation-faithfulness literature precedes our system.

sources.title: IndicNLPSuite: Monolingual Corpora, Evaluation Benchmarks and Pre-trained Multilingual Language Models for Indian Languages
sources.assessment: Indic multilingual language models and evaluation datasets already established.

sources.title: Towards Leaving No Indic Language Behind: Building Monolingual Corpora, Benchmark and Models for Indic Languages
sources.assessment: Human-supervised IndicXTREME provides stronger multilingual benchmark precedent.

sources.title: Leak, Cheat, Repeat: Data Contamination and Evaluation Malpractices in Closed-Source LLMs
sources.authors: Simone Balloccu; Patrícia Schmidtová; Mateusz Lango; Ondrej Dusek
sources.assessment: Contamination/reproducibility concern previously documented for model benchmarking.

sources.title: Investigating Data Contamination in Modern Benchmarks for Large Language Models
sources.authors: Chunyuan Deng; Yilun Zhao; Xiangru Tang; Mark Gerstein; Arman Cohan
sources.assessment: Test-data contamination detection approaches already exist.

sources.title: A Taxonomy for Data Contamination in Large Language Models
sources.authors: Medha Palavalli; Amanda Bertsch; Matthew Gormley
sources.assessment: Altered test data can evade overlap checks; absence of n-gram overlap is not proof of independence.

sources.title: Learning to Discover: A Generalized Framework for Raga Identification without Forgetting
sources.assessment: Audio unseen-Raag discovery task; does not establish poetry task but counters broader Raag AI novelty assertions.
